No realistic facial modeling, elaborate brocade, modern anime, 3D, glossy digital painting or dense brown noise. Preserve ancient Chinese clothing and props. No props/events copied from the reference.
CHARACTERS AND INVARIANTS: 陈平年轻成年青绿袍黑束发；父老白须土黄袍；祭肉已煮熟置木盘，无屠宰。六格依次准备、分配、领取、称赞、回应、交谈，不画登基。
Scenes, exactly in this order (Chinese captions here describe events to ILLUSTRATE; never render their text):
1. 乡里举行祭社活动，陈平被安排主管分肉。
2. 他把祭肉分给参加的人，处置得很均衡。
3. 肉一份份分出去，父老看见了他的做法。
